engines.hint: The right engine is prompted the first time you install a model of that family; you can also pre-install one here on demand. Engines download locally and installed ones are skipped automatically. You can check for official updates below.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hfTokenHint: Only needed for gated models such as LTX-2.5: accept the license on the HuggingFace repo page first, then paste your Token here. Stored locally only.
settings.msTokenHint: Only needed for private / gated repos; public search and downloads do not require it. Stored locally only.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Kevrai Omni — three steps to get started
onboarding.step1Body: Open the AI Engines page and install the engine you need (e.g. llama.cpp). Engines download on demand; installed ones are skipped automatically.
onboarding.step2Body: Search the Model Market and install a model (e.g. Qwen3.8 GGUF). You can also drag model files from your disk straight in.
onboarding.step3Body: Chat, draw, make video: pick a model → type a prompt → hit generate. That's it.
onboarding.gatedHint: Models marked ⓘ are gated. Before downloading, fill in your HF Token under Settings.
